description: This file defines the ReasonerContext class and a helper function to obtain the current context within an execution environment. It encapsulates various properties related to the reasoning process, including identifiers, HTTP request and response objects, agent, AI client, memory, workflow, and DID interface. The class also provides methods for AI interactions, invocation, discovery, and logging.

classes.name: ReasonerContext
classes.description: A context class that encapsulates the execution environment for reasoning tasks, providing access to input data, identifiers, agents, AI services, memory, workflow, and DIDs, along with methods for AI communication, invocation, discovery, and logging.

methods.name: ai
methods.description: Sends a prompt to the AI client, optionally with schema, and returns the AI's response as a typed object or string.

methods.name: aiStream
methods.description: Streams AI response to a prompt via the AI client.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Invokes a secondary agent or service with specified input.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Performs a discovery operation via the agent.

methods.name: note
methods.description: Logs a message with optional tags within the context of the current execution.

methods.name: export function getCurrentContext<TInput = any>(): ReasonerContext<TInput> | undefined { getCurrentContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current ReasonerContext instance based on execution metadata.
